tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the identity of the current token holder (account + provider) plus its subscription plan (free | plus) and the plan's limits: max running projects, per-project memory/CPU caps, log windows, and the project-database fair-use guide. Free plans include an upgrade_url for Plus ($9.99/mo: 5 projec

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Start onboarding: require an email, create a pending account, and email a human verify link. Does NOT return an API token. The human must click the link; the verify page shows the token once. Then configure Authorization: Bearer <token> on this MCP client (also docker login -u <token> registry.fiskm

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Poll onboarding state for an email (pending | active | unknown). Use after create_account while waiting for the human to verify.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Delete the caller's account. Stops and removes all projects (containers, routes, MariaDB) first, then deletes the account. Refuses to leave orphaned runtimes.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project and reserve <slug>-app.fiskmas.dev. Slug must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,48}$ and is not reserved. Subject to the plan's running-project quota (Free: 1, Plus: 5) — on quota the error tells the human how to upgrade or free a slot.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the caller's projects with status and URL.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch a single project by id or slug.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Stop and delete a project (free the slug after quarantine).

tools.name: set_env
tools.description: Set environment variables on a project. Requires a restart before they take effect.

tools.name: list_env
tools.description: List a project's env keys with masked values (never returns full secrets).

tools.name: deploy_project
tools.description: Pull an image by digest and run one container with the plan's cpu/memory caps (Free: 128 MB / 0.2 CPU, Plus: 256 MB / 0.5 CPU). Only registry.fiskmas.dev images are accepted. Rate-limited to 1 deploy per 5 minutes per account (429 with a retry-seconds hint); use restart_project for a transient crash

tools.name: start_project
tools.description: Start a stopped project's container.

tools.name: stop_project
tools.description: Stop a running project's container (keep the image).

tools.name: restart_project
tools.description: Restart a running project's container.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Return project status, url, image digest, and last deploy error.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Return recent container log lines. `tail` = line count (plan default 200; plan max 2000), `since` = time window in seconds (plan window: free 24 h, plus 7 d — logs are live-pod streams, not stored history). When both are given, `since` wins.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Account-wide or per-project stats for debugging: live CPU/mem vs the plan caps (Free: 128 MB / 0.2 CPU, Plus: 256 MB / 0.5 CPU) and deploy history. Omit `project` for all of the caller's projects; pass a project id or slug for a single project. The account rollup also reports the plan and per-projec

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem with the Fiskmås toolset so it can be fixed. Use it when a tool errored or misbehaved, you got stuck and can't proceed, or the instructions/skill were unclear. tools.description: List the platform skills available to the caller.

tools.name: get_skill

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_projects, get_status · Private data: whoami, create_account, set_env, list_env · Public sink: create_account, account_status, send_feedback · Destructive: delete_account, delete_project, deploy_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_projects, get_status · Private data: whoami, create_account, set_env, list_env · Public sink: create_account, account_status, send_feedback · Destructive: delete_account, delete_project, deploy_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
